propositions: Code review lacks a concurrency rubric to detect races on shared resources; existing overlays only cover TOCTOU and load-shaped concurrency.

A deterministic two-layer lexical trigger (committed high-precision tokens plus project-extensible vocabulary) must enable the concurrency overlay to fire on diffs bearing synchronization primitives and project-specific patterns.

The committed tier deliberately does not fire on unlocked-twin races (raw git operations, file-lock reclaims) because portable recall requires project-specific vocabulary, establishing an accepted recall boundary.
Built-in overlays must support extensible trigger vocabulary and applies_to globs through criteria_routing.json without code changes.
The concurrency overlay ships advisory (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) pending calibration volume.
